decided: When the sign-off setting holds a value orbit does not read, the hold's one-line report stays alone on its normal output and the warning goes to the error output; the structured form carries the warning as a field.
alternatives: Print the warning as a second line of the normal output.
Leave the warning out of the one-line form.
why: The hold is specified to print one line, and a person running it still needs to see that their value was ignored; the archive reads the structured form, where the warning is a field it states in one line.
detail: BriefCommand.hold in src/commands/brief.ts: console.error for the warning in text mode; --json carries warning.
